structured.answer: I'd go with A, the one with the single tall column. It clicked straight away: 66,513 ₪ on the קרן side and 19,595 ₪ on the other, with a huge yellow block of "הפקדות המעסיק 54,000 ₪". So yes, joining is obviously worth it. B shows the same numbers, but they're split across nine steps and I had to hunt for them.

stuck.where: Option A, top of the tall column, "מס במשיכה −13,974 ₪"
stuck.why: Red hatching and a big minus. For a second it looked like I'd lose 14K. Then the 6-year chart below showed 0 ₪ tax, so I guess it's only if you take the money out early. I'm not totally sure I got that right.

stuck.where: "כל שקל שהפקדתם נהיה 3.70 ₪ בקרן ו-1.09 ₪ בחשבון ניירות ערך"
stuck.why: I didn't really know what the "חשבון ניירות ערך" side was. I guessed it means investing in the S&P on your own.
The bars float at different heights and I had to jump left and right to follow them. Each one is separate, so I lost the sense of one big pile.

Option A heading "א. עמודה לכל דרך" and the "מומלץ" tag

The second chart in A at 6 years: 98,738 ₪ vs 23,973 ₪, tax 0 ₪
Option B heading "ב. כל חלק בעמודה משלו" and its waterfall
skimmed: The small thumbnail of the old version (balls and table)
Intro lines under A and B
Tabs שכירים / עצמאים (I left it on שכירים)
skipped: The orange/grey example paragraph (salary 12,000 ₪, inflation, 7.5%, track number, fees 0.54%)

unsure_meaning: מס במשיכה: is that something I pay for sure, or only if I take the money out before 6 years?
חשבון ניירות ערך: is it the S&P thing my friends do?
רווח אחרי דמי ניהול: I didn't see how much the fee was in shekels
Teal colour = profit? I guessed from the label next to it
Red hatched stripes: I took them to mean tax/minus
The circled number 5 or 6 under the bars: I guessed it's the year you take the money out
not_found: The management fee in shekels (only small percents in grey text)
What I actually do first to join, or who runs my fund
A plain sentence saying whether I can take the money out before 6 years

findings.what: The red, hatched −13,974 ₪ sits right on top of the biggest column and scares you off before you understand it only applies before year 6
findings.where: Option A, 5-year chart, top of the קרן column

findings.what: "−13,974 ₪" with the minus and ₪ at the far left is easy to misread, and on a quick look it seems bigger than the profit
The waterfall makes you add the steps in your head; the totals are small labels on floating bars
I never found out what the חשבון ניירות ערך option is; it's just a name
The fees are only in a tiny grey percent line I'd never read; no shekel amount
findings.where: Grey line under Option A's chart

findings.what: Charts on a dark background with tiny grey text: hard to read on a phone on the bus
